title: Ship-Now Shipments on a Shared Household Food Tailwise Autoship
content:
Ship-now shipments shorten the days between shipments of a shared household food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship (a non-prescription food subscription that feeds more than one pet of the household).

- Two or more ship-now shipments charged on the subscription in the last six months: 4 days are taken away.
- Exactly one: 2 days are taken away.
- None: no days are taken away.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

| Hypothetical history | Days taken away |
|---|---|
| One ship-now shipment charged two months ago | 2 |
| One charged two months ago and one eight months ago | 2 (only one falls in the last six months) |
| Two charged in the last six months | 4 |
